messages:
alex: Quick sync — KV eviction heuristics canary results are in. Unexpected tail latency spike on long-context tests, need quick triage.

maria: Share numbers?

alex: Short summary: p95 +12ms, p99 +80ms on 16k sequence runs. Avg throughput roughly the same. Canary pool: ded-rt-canary-3.

chen: Did the async prefetch kernel change land? I thought we gated it.

alex: Yes, `kvcache/prefetch: async-prefetch-v4` merged yesterday. Also the `continuous-batch:task-split` kernel optimization landed earlier this week — could be interaction.

sam: Ping @leo and @eng-platform — could this be increased CPU / scheduler churn from extra coroutines?

leo: I looked at the canary logs. Seeing more syscall wakes. Mini dump shows epoll wakeups jump. Snippet: ```syscall counts: epoll_wait 124k -> 187k; context_switches 42k -> 68k```

irene: Can we toggle prefetch to sync or roll back the batch change to isolate?

alex: Toggling the env flag now: switching `KV_PREFETCH_MODE=async` -> `sync` on ded-rt-canary-3.

deploy-bot: Toggle request accepted — changed KV_PREFETCH_MODE on ded-rt-canary-3 from async to sync. Start time 1910456820.

maria: CI also reported a failing perf job: `long_context_throughput` timed out (5m). Might be related.

chen: If the toggle fixes it, we should split rollouts: prefetch separate from continuous-batch. Add a perf gate.

alex: Proposed plan: 1) keep prefetch async off on canary; 2) run a 2-hour perf suite overnight; 3) if stable, reintroduce async with throttling; 4) open CR for instrumentation: track `kvcache.evictions` and `batch_queue_latency_ms` per model.

sam: :eyes: I'll add the perf gate to the rollout pipeline. Who owns the instrumentation CR? @maria?

maria: I'll take the instrumentation CR. Will post PR link when ready. Queries I'll add to dashboards: `sum by (model) (rate(kvcache_evictions_total[5m]))` and `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(batch_queue_latency_ms_bucket[5m])))`.

leo: I'll dig into the epoll wakeups and scheduler behavior. Locally I reproduced similar latency with small sim — thinking coroutine redistribution causes more frequent wakes. I'll propose a kernel patch.

irene: Quick question on ownership: when we promote to Dedicated, who triages perf alerts? Runtime oncall or Platform oncall?

alex: Runtime oncall first, platform second. We should add a runbook note and escalation path.

sam: Noted. Also cc'ing PMs — this could affect SLA for high-context customers. Please flag in product if we see persistent regression. @pm-jess

chen: I'll add a canary perf job command for tonight: `./scripts/perf-run --suite long_context --duration 2h --pool ded-rt-canary-3`

maria: Good. Also adding checklist here: [ ] toggle off prefetch (done) [ ] kick off perf suite (pending) [ ] instrumentation PR (maria) [ ] kernel rollback/patch plan (alex/leo) [ ] runbook update (alex).

alex: Thanks all — I'll post results ~1h after the toggle completes. If p99 doesn't improve we'll cut the `continuous-batch` kernel change from the canary.

leo: FYI I have a local patch to reduce epoll wake frequency by batching timers — will open draft.

sam: :thumbsup: tagging this thread for eng-runtime weekly visibility.

maria: Ending note: metric queries and dashboards are important here — please add model-level breakdowns so we can correlate evictions with specific model configs.

alex: Closing loop for now. Will update when perf suite finishes. (expected next update at 1910456950)
